instruments.name: Three-pump layout (lab default)
instruments.notes: Aqueous (RNA) and lipid pumps into the mixer, a third pump adds the quench buffer after it. The layout every record in the app assumed before devices were listed.

instruments.name: NanoScaler
instruments.notes: HPLC-pump based system; impinging jet mixers in sizes IJM 1 to IJM 5, or a T-mixer, with an optional third pump for inline dilution.

instruments.name: NanoAssemblr Ignite
instruments.notes: Benchtop system with a disposable NxGen cartridge; aqueous and lipid phase from syringes, dilution done offline.

instruments.name: Syringe pumps
instruments.notes: Two syringe pumps into a T-mixer or a microfluidic chip; a third syringe or an offline dilution as quench.

mixers.name: T-mixer
mixers.notes: Two opposed or perpendicular inlets meeting in one outlet; turbulent mixing at high flow.

mixers.name: Impinging jet mixer (IJM)
mixers.notes: Two jets collide head-on in a small chamber; mixing time set by the jet velocity. A generic entry, kept for records made before the KNAUER sizes were listed.

mixers.name: KNAUER IJM 1
mixers.notes: Impinging jet mixer for the NanoScaler, size 1 of 5 (the smallest). The sizes increase from IJM 1 to IJM 5. Enter the chamber and jet diameters and the flow range from the KNAUER datasheet; they are not filled in here.

mixers.name: KNAUER IJM 2
mixers.notes: Impinging jet mixer for the NanoScaler, size 2 of 5. The sizes increase from IJM 1 to IJM 5. Enter the chamber and jet diameters and the flow range from the KNAUER datasheet; they are not filled in here.

mixers.name: KNAUER IJM 3
mixers.notes: Impinging jet mixer for the NanoScaler, size 3 of 5. The sizes increase from IJM 1 to IJM 5. Enter the chamber and jet diameters and the flow range from the KNAUER datasheet; they are not filled in here.

mixers.name: KNAUER IJM 4
mixers.notes: Impinging jet mixer for the NanoScaler, size 4 of 5. The sizes increase from IJM 1 to IJM 5. Enter the chamber and jet diameters and the flow range from the KNAUER datasheet; they are not filled in here.

mixers.name: KNAUER IJM 5
mixers.notes: Impinging jet mixer for the NanoScaler, size 5 of 5 (the largest). The sizes increase from IJM 1 to IJM 5. Enter the chamber and jet diameters and the flow range from the KNAUER datasheet; they are not filled in here.

mixers.name: NxGen cartridge
mixers.notes: Disposable cartridge with toroidal (bifurcating) mixing elements.

mixers.name: Staggered herringbone chip
mixers.notes: Chaotic advection over grooved channel walls; laminar flow, mixing within milliseconds.

mixers.name: Hydrodynamic flow-focusing chip
mixers.notes: The lipid stream is focused between two aqueous sheath streams; mixing by diffusion across a narrow sheet.
